items.title: 过去将来时的构成与语境
items.brief: 过去参照点之后的将来：would do

concept.summary: 过去将来时表示以过去某一时刻为参照点、在该点之后才发生的动作，构成是 would + 动词原形，或 was/were going to + 动词原形。它的出现条件是句中必须存在过去参照点：主句谓语为过去时（said, thought, knew, promised），或出现明确的过去时间状语。它与一般将来时的唯一区别是参照点落在过去，因此不能脱离过去语境单独使用。

sections.p: 过去将来不是一个单词形式，而是四种结构的统称：would do、was/were going to do、was/were to do、was/were about to do。它们在计划性与正式程度上依次不同，但都要求过去参照点。
bullets: would + 原形：He told me he would wait at the gate.
was/were going to + 原形：She said she was going to resign.
was/were to + 原形：The minister was to arrive at noon.（正式，表安排）
was/were about to + 原形：We were about to leave when the phone rang.（表即将）

sections.p: 过去将来时是相对时态，时间定位完全依赖另一个过去动作或过去时间。没有参照点，句子就没有“将来”可言。间接引语是最集中的语境：直接引语中的 will 后移为 would，is going to 后移为 was going to。
bullets: He said, "I will come." → He said he would come.
She said, "I am going to quit." → She said she was going to quit.
I was sure the plan would work.
They knew the train would be late.

sections.h: 与表过去习惯的 would 区分
sections.p: would 还有第二个身份：表示过去反复发生的习惯动作。两者形式相同，靠语境分辨——过去将来的动作只发生一次且位于参照点之后，过去习惯的动作反复发生，常与 often, every day, whenever 连用。
bullets: 过去将来：He promised he would write once a week.（一次承诺，指向未来）
过去习惯：When I was a boy, I would swim in this river every summer.（反复）
过去习惯可用 used to 替换，过去将来不能

examples.en: He promised he would send me the files that evening.
examples.zh: 他答应那天晚上把文件发给我。
examples.note: 主句 promised 为过去时，宾语从句的将来后移为 would send。

examples.en: I thought the train was going to be late, and it was.
examples.zh: 我当时觉得火车会晚点，果然如此。
examples.note: thought 提供过去参照点，was going to be 表示当时的预料。

examples.en: She said she was to hand in the paper on Monday.
examples.zh: 她说她周一要交论文。
examples.note: was to do 表按安排应当发生，是过去将来时的正式形式。

examples.en: We were about to leave when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我们正要离开，电话响了。
examples.note: was/were about to do 表示过去某点即将发生，常与 when 从句连用。

examples.en: He told me he would went there alone.
examples.zh: 他告诉我他会一个人去那里。
examples.note: would 是情态助动词，后面必须接动词原形 go，不能用过去式 went。

examples.en: She said she will be busy that night.
examples.zh: 她说她那天晚上会很忙。
examples.note: 主句 said 为过去时，间接引语中的将来要后移为 would be，不能保留 will。

examples.en: They told us they would arrived at noon.
examples.zh: 他们告诉我们中午到。
examples.note: would 后接动词原形 arrive，任何情况下都不能接过去式。

pitfalls.wrong: She said she will be busy that night.
pitfalls.right: She said she would be busy that night.
pitfalls.why: 主句谓语 said 是过去时，宾语从句的将来时间必须后移为过去将来，will 变 would。

pitfalls.wrong: They told us they would arrived at noon.
pitfalls.right: They told us they would arrive at noon.
pitfalls.why: would 是情态助动词，只带动词原形，时态信息已经由 would 承担，主动词不再变形。

pitfalls.wrong: I was going to called you, but I lost your number.
pitfalls.right: I was going to call you, but I lost your number.
pitfalls.why: be going to 中的 to 是不定式符号，后面一律接动词原形。

contrast.withTitle: would do 与 was going to do 的差别
contrast.diff: 本知识点解决“怎么构成、何时必须出现”；would 与 be going to 的语义分工（意愿推测还是已有计划）由下一知识点处理。

concept.mnemonic: 过去时刻往后看，will 变 would；有参照点才成立，无参照点不成句。

core: 四种形式：would do / was going to do / was to do / was about to do
必要条件：句中必须有过去参照点（said, thought, promised 或过去时间状语）
间接引语后移：will → would，is going to → was going to
would 后永远接动词原形，不接过去式
与过去习惯的 would 靠“一次还是反复”区分
review.trigger: 看到主句是 said / thought / promised 且从句讲以后的事 → 把 will 换成 would

quickCheck.q: He said he ___ (come) the next day. 填什么？
would 后面能接 went 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能接动词原形 go。

quickCheck.q: was about to do 表示什么？
quickCheck.a: 过去某点即将发生，常与 when 从句连用。

drills.stem: He promised that he ___ us at the airport at seven.
drills.explain: 主句 promised 是过去时，宾语从句表示该过去时刻之后的动作，须用过去将来时 would + 原形。
drills.trap: will meet 没有随主句时态后移；would have met 表“本来会见面”，与承诺语义不符。

drills.stem: She told me she ___ (be) free that afternoon.
drills.hint: 主句 told 是过去时，从句讲的是那之后的状态。
drills.explain: 宾语从句的将来随主句过去时后移，will be 变为 would be，且 would 后接原形 be。

drills.stem: The manager said he will sign the contract the next day.
drills.answer: The manager said he would sign the contract the next day.
accept: The manager said he would sign the contract the next day.
drills.explain: 主句 said 为过去时，间接引语中的 will 必须后移为 would，才能与参照点一致。

drills.stem: We ___ leave when the lights suddenly went out.
drills.explain: was/were about to do 表示过去某一点即将发生，与 when 引导的突发动作搭配，构成“正要……这时……”的典型句式。
drills.trap: would 后虽可接原形 leave，但只表意愿或推测，无法表达“即将”这一时间紧迫感。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He said he would return the following week.
drills.explain: 主句 said 提供过去参照点，从句用 would + 原形 return，the following week 是间接引语中 tomorrow 类时间的后移形式。

drills.stem: 她告诉我她第二天会给我打电话。
drills.answer: She told me she would call me the next day.
drills.explain: 主句 told 为过去时，从句的将来后移为 would call；直接引语中的 tomorrow 在间接引语中改为 the next day。

items.title: would do 与 was going to do 的差别
items.brief: would 表意愿或推测，be going to 表已有计划

concept.summary: 两者都能表过去将来，但语义侧重不同：would do 强调主语当时的意愿、承诺或说话人的推测，计划性弱；was/were going to do 强调参照点之前已经形成的计划，或已有迹象表明即将发生。句中若出现 plan, decide, intend, make up one's mind 等计划性词语，或要表达“原本打算却没做”，只能用 be going to。

sections.p: would 的核心是主语的主观态度，动作是否真的发生并不确定。它常跟在 say, promise, hope, think, be sure 之后，也可以是说话人对过去情况的判断。
bullets: 意愿：He said he would do anything to help.
承诺：She promised she would never tell anyone.
推测：We were sure the scheme would work.
注意：Would you like...? 是礼貌请求，与过去将来无关

sections.h: be going to：已有计划与已有迹象
sections.p: be going to 的前提是“参照点之前事情已经定了”，因此常与表示决定的词语同现。它还能表示根据当前迹象推断即将发生，此时 would 完全不能用。
bullets: 计划：She had decided that she was going to study law.
迹象：Dark clouds gathered; it was going to rain.
原本打算：I was going to call you, but my phone died.

sections.p: 第一处是“计划落空”，只有 was/were going to 能承载“本来打算却没实现”的含义。第二处是形式叠加，would 与 be going to 是两套独立结构，不能拼成 would going to。
bullets: 计划落空：We were going to leave the next morning, but the flight was cancelled.
形式错误：× She said she would going to resign.
正确改写：She said she was going to resign. / She said she would resign.

examples.en: He said he would do anything to help us.
examples.zh: 他说他愿意尽一切努力帮我们。
examples.note: would 表意愿，是否落实并不确定。

examples.en: She had made up her mind that she was going to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她当时已下定决心要当医生。
examples.note: made up her mind 是计划性信号，用 was going to 表示决定已形成。

examples.en: I was going to tell you, but you had already heard the news.
examples.zh: 我本来想告诉你，可你已经听说这个消息了。
examples.note: was going to 表“原本打算却没做”，but 分句交代计划落空。

examples.en: We were sure the experiment would fail without more data.
examples.zh: 我们确信没有更多数据实验会失败。
examples.note: would 表当时的推测，没有计划含义。

examples.en: She told me she would going to resign.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她打算辞职。
examples.note: would 与 be going to 是两套结构，不能叠加，应改为 was going to resign 或 would resign。

examples.en: I was going to called you last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚本来想给你打电话。
examples.note: be going to 后接动词原形 call，不能接过去式。

examples.en: The sky was dark and the wind was rising; it was going to rain.
examples.zh: 天色暗下来，风也起了，快要下雨了。
examples.note: 根据眼前迹象推断即将发生，只能用 be going to，不能用 would。

pitfalls.wrong: She told me she would going to resign.
pitfalls.right: She told me she was going to resign.
pitfalls.why: would 与 be going to 分属两套结构，不能拼接；表已有计划应整体换成 was going to。

pitfalls.wrong: We would leave the next morning, but the flight was cancelled.
pitfalls.right: We were going to leave the next morning, but the flight was cancelled.
pitfalls.why: “原本打算却未实现”只能由 was/were going to 承担，would 只表意愿或推测，不含计划落空义。

pitfalls.wrong: Look at those clouds. It would rain.
pitfalls.right: Look at those clouds. It was going to rain.
pitfalls.why: 根据迹象推断即将发生必须用 be going to，would 不能用来描述眼前可见的迹象。

contrast.withTitle: 过去将来时的构成与语境
contrast.diff: 构成点解决形式与出现条件，本点解决同一语境下 would 与 be going to 的语义分工：一个是主观意愿，一个是既定计划。

concept.mnemonic: would 是心里想，going to 是已经定；计划落空用后者，两套结构不叠加。

core: would：意愿、承诺、推测，计划性弱
be going to：参照点之前已定的计划，或已有迹象
plan / decide / intend / make up one's mind 出现时选 be going to
原本打算却没做，只能用 was/were going to
would 与 be going to 不能叠加成 would going to
review.trigger: 看到 but 分句交代计划落空，或句中有 plan / decide → 用 was/were going to

quickCheck.q: “我本来想打电话给你，但手机没电了”用哪个结构？
quickCheck.a: I was going to call you.
不能，两套结构不能叠加。

quickCheck.q: 看见乌云说“要下雨了”，用 would 还是 was going to？
quickCheck.a: was going to，因为是根据迹象推断。

drills.stem: I ___ call you yesterday, but I couldn't find your number.
drills.explain: but 分句说明计划没有实现，只有 was/were going to 能表达“原本打算却没做”。
drills.trap: would 只表意愿或推测，不承载“计划落空”的含义，与 but 分句的逻辑接不上。

drills.stem: At first the managers ___ (not / be going to) approve the budget, but they changed their minds.
drills.hint: 括号已给出结构，只需把 be going to 变过去式并加否定。
drills.explain: 主语 managers 为复数，be going to 的过去式用 were，否定为 were not going to，表示“原本不打算”，与 but 分句的改变主意形成对照。

drills.stem: She told me she would going to resign at the end of the month.
drills.answer: She told me she was going to resign at the end of the month.
accept: She told me she was going to resign at the end of the month.
drills.explain: would 与 be going to 是两套独立结构，不能叠加；辞职是已定的计划，应整体改为 was going to resign。

drills.stem: Nobody expected that the little firm ___ such a huge order.
drills.explain: expected 为过去时，从句用过去将来时 would + 动词原形 win 表示当时对未来结果的推测。
drills.trap: would won 把情态助动词当成了时态标记，后面又重复使用过去式，属于双重变形。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I was going to tell you, but you already knew.
drills.explain: was going to tell 表示原本打算说，but 分句说明这个打算没有必要实现，构成计划落空的典型表达。

drills.stem: 我本来打算昨天给你打电话，但我的手机没电了。
drills.answer: I was going to call you yesterday, but my phone was dead.
drills.explain: “本来打算”必须用 was going to do，but 分句说明计划没有实现；would 不能承担这一含义。

items.title: 过去将来完成时
items.brief: 站在过去看：到过去某点将会已完成

concept.summary: 过去将来完成时 would have done 表示以过去某一时刻为参照点，动作在该点之前将会完成。它是将来完成时 will have done 的整体后移：will 变 would，have done 保持不变。常见于间接引语与过去的预期，判定关键是句中同时存在“过去参照点”和“早于该点的完成界限”。同一形式也出现在虚拟语气主句，需靠条件句或反事实语境区分。

sections.p: 时态后移只改第一个助动词，完成体内部结构不动。记住三条对应，就能把直接引语中的任何将来完成形式改写成过去将来完成形式。
bullets: will have done → would have done
will have been doing → would have been doing
will be doing → would be doing
例句：He said, "I will have finished by Friday." → He said he would have finished by Friday.

sections.p: 第一是间接引语，主句为过去时，从句的将来完成随之后移。第二是过去的预期，主句用 expected, hoped, believed 等，从句说明“到某个过去时点之前应已完成”。
bullets: 间接引语：She said she would have left by the time we arrived.
过去预期：We expected that the workers would have finished by June.
被动形式：We hoped the bridge would have been rebuilt by then.

sections.h: 与虚拟语气同形，如何区分
sections.p: would have done 有两种身份：过去将来完成时，动作在过去的预期中可能真的发生了；虚拟语气主句，动作与过去事实相反，实际没有发生。判断依据是有无 if 条件句或明确的反事实语境。
bullets: 过去将来完成：He told me he would have completed the draft by Friday.（可能完成）
虚拟语气：If you had told me earlier, I would have booked the tickets.（实际没订）
虚拟条件句的从句用 had done，would have done 只出现在主句

examples.en: He told me he would have completed the draft by the end of the week.
examples.zh: 他告诉我他到周末会把初稿写完。
examples.note: told 是过去参照点，by the end of the week 是完成界限，构成过去将来完成时。

examples.en: We hoped that the bridge would have been rebuilt by the time the school opened.
examples.zh: 我们曾希望学校开学时桥已经重建好。
examples.note: hoped 提供过去参照点，被动形式为 would have been + 过去分词。

examples.en: She said she would have been working there for ten years by then.
examples.zh: 她说那时她就在那里工作满十年了。
examples.note: would have been doing 是将来完成进行时的后移形式，强调持续到该点。

examples.en: If you had told me earlier, I would have booked the tickets.
examples.zh: 你要是早点告诉我，我就订票了。
examples.note: 这是与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，would have done 出现在主句，不是过去将来完成时。

examples.en: He said he would has finished the report by Friday.
examples.zh: 他说他周五前会写完报告。
examples.note: would 后必须接原形 have，完成体固定为 would have done，不能写成 would has。

examples.en: By the time we got there, they would finished the meal.
examples.zh: 我们到的时候，他们本该已经吃完那顿饭了。
examples.note: 完成体缺少 have，应为 would have finished；would 不能直接接过去分词。

examples.en: He said he will have finished the work by then.
examples.zh: 他说到那时他已经完成这项工作了。
examples.note: 主句 said 为过去时，从句的将来完成须后移为 would have finished。

pitfalls.wrong: She said she would have finish the essay by Monday.
pitfalls.right: She said she would have finished the essay by Monday.
pitfalls.why: would have 后必须接过去分词构成完成体，finish 是原形，不能直接跟在 have 之后。

pitfalls.wrong: We expected that they would finished the design by May.
pitfalls.right: We expected that they would have finished the design by May.
pitfalls.why: 表“到过去某点之前已完成”必须用 would have done；would finished 在结构上不成立。

pitfalls.wrong: If I would have known the schedule, I would have come earlier.
pitfalls.right: If I had known the schedule, I would have come earlier.
pitfalls.why: 虚拟条件句的从句用 had done，would have done 只能出现在主句，放在 if 从句里是典型错误。

contrast.diff: 将来完成时以现在为出发点看向将来某点，过去将来完成时以过去某点为出发点，形式只差 will 与 would。

concept.mnemonic: will 变 would，have done 不动；有 if 是虚拟，无 if 是后移。

core: 结构：would have + 过去分词，被动 would have been done
由将来完成时整体后移：will → would，have done 不变
典型语境：间接引语、过去的预期（expected / hoped / believed）
与虚拟语气同形，靠有无 if 条件句或反事实语境区分
完成体里 have 永远是原形，不随主语变 has
review.trigger: 看到主句为过去时，从句又有 by + 过去时间 → 用 would have done

quickCheck.q: will have finished 后移成什么？
如何判断 would have done 是虚拟还是过去将来完成？
quickCheck.a: 看有无 if 条件句或反事实语境。

drills.stem: He told us that the workers ___ the roof by the time the rainy season began.
drills.explain: told 是过去参照点，by the time the rainy season began 是过去的完成界限，须用过去将来完成时 would have done。
drills.trap: would repair 只表过去将来，未体现“在雨季开始之前已完成”的先后关系。

drills.stem: She said she ___ (finish) the translation by the end of that month.
drills.hint: 主句 said 是过去时，by the end of that month 是过去的截止点。
drills.explain: 将来完成时 will have finished 随主句过去时后移，will 变 would，完成体部分不变。

drills.stem: They expected that the new library would has opened by September.
drills.answer: They expected that the new library would have opened by September.
accept: They expected that the new library would have opened by September.
drills.explain: would 后接原形 have，构成 would have done；have 不随主语变化，不能写成 has。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He said he would have left by then.
drills.explain: said 提供过去参照点，by then 指过去某点之前，从句用 would have left 表完成。

drills.stem: By the time the guests arrived, the cook ___ the whole meal.
drills.explain: arrived 是过去参照点，prepare 的动作发生在该点之前并已完成，用 would have prepared。
drills.trap: would prepare 只表示过去将来，无法体现“在客人到达前已完成”的先后关系。

drills.stem: 他说到那时他已经写完论文了。
drills.answer: He said he would have finished his paper by then.
drills.explain: 主句 said 为过去时，by then 指过去某点之前，从句用过去将来完成时 would have finished。
